status: RENDERED LOCALLY, NOT UPLOADED. This plan is the 2026-10-06 take, rendered at 48010c9. Its content opens on Android TV emulator footage from CI run 37475795991: the debug APK built at f423ba5 on an AOSP Android TV emulator, Android 14 / API 34, loading the public demo (build ea2cff5, record-only), at 1x, with two holds of a static frame. That is footage, not a Fire TV device and not a runtime receipt; the Android TV emulator runtime receipt is a separate file, android_tv_runtime_receipt.json. The rest is a local run of this repository in desktop Chromium at 1920x1080 CSS (the desktop layout, not the Fire TV WebView's 960x540 CSS) with MERCURY_OFFLINE=1, driven through the D-pad bridge the Leanback app calls. An emulator beat's seconds are its footage window plus its holds; a desktop beat's seconds are its measured hold, the length of its synthesized audio plus a 0.65 s tail, from video/generate-narration.py. The media lives outside the repository; video/README.md says where. The event FAQ permits the Android TV Emulator and does not require physical hardware.
